# NRH-SCI-Vent

## Purpose
Public Stata analysis repository for the cervical spinal cord injury ventilator-weaning cohort study at the University of Utah Craig H. Neilsen Rehabilitation Hospital.

Final paper: Fenger C, Locke BW, Barker J, Tang W, Creveling P, Foster-Palmer S, Flis A, Park K, Rosenbluth J, Brown JP. Post-Acute Ventilator Weaning and Discharge Outcomes in Individuals With Cervical Spinal Cord Injury. Respiratory Care. 2026;71(4):351-357.

## Canonical identifiers
- Repository: https://github.com/reblocke/NRH-SCI-Vent
- Final article DOI: https://doi.org/10.1177/19433654261428406
- PubMed: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41823210/
- Paper and author-response code release: https://github.com/reblocke/NRH-SCI-Vent/releases/tag/v0.2.0
- Original manuscript snapshot release: https://github.com/reblocke/NRH-SCI-Vent/releases/tag/v0.1.0
- Author response DOI: https://doi.org/10.1177/19433654261450544

## What is in this repository
- `run_all.do`: canonical smoke/full/release orchestration, fail-fast dependency/input/source-contract staging, mapping-aware preprocessing, output-presence checks, and value-free run evidence.
- `config/`: shared defaults plus smoke and release profile configuration.
- `code/00_preflight.do`: offline SHA-256 and controlled-ado resolution gate
  that runs before any source-data check.
- `code/lib/data_contracts.do`: source-contract version 2 enforcement for the
  ordered 36-field storage, missingness, domain, date, identifier, and timing
  rules with aggregate-only private logs.
- `code/lib/value_mappings.do`: deterministic executor for mapping-contract
  version 1 at `validation/value_mappings.csv`; unlisted categorical input
  fails rather than being guessed.
- `scripts/`: POSIX and PowerShell smoke launchers plus a Stata status adapter.
- `vendor/stata/`: exact seven-file runtime closure, dependency manifest, and
  third-party license notices.
- `NRH SCI Cohort Preprocessing.do`: imports the restricted source CSV, creates Stata analysis datasets, and derives analytic variables.
- `NRH SCI Cohort Paper Analysis.do`: produces the paper tables, figures, proportional-odds models, Fine-Gray competing-risk models, and Kaplan-Meier outputs.
- `NRH SCI Cohort Supplemental Sensitivity Analyses.do`: produces the supplemental figures and correspondence table used in the published author response.
- `README.md`: human-readable project overview, run instructions, article links, and paper-code mapping.
- `DECISIONS.md`: public record of the eight approved NRH-004 scientific and
  data-governance decisions using role/date/opaque-artifact metadata only.
- `CITATION.cff`: software and preferred article citation metadata.
- `data_dictionary.md` and `data_dictionary.csv`: public documentation of expected restricted inputs, derived analysis variables, outputs, and review flags.
- `AGENTS.md`: repository-specific instructions for future coding agents.
- `PROJECT.yml` and `validation/`: authorized-baseline metadata and public
  value-free baseline, source, and mapping contracts.
- `vendor/stata/manifest.csv`: exact package versions, sources, licenses,
  controlled paths, and SHA-256 hashes.

## Data restrictions
The source data are restricted retrospective EHR data governed by University of Utah IRB #00153003. Do not commit PHI, row-level clinical data, cleaned analysis datasets, intermediate `.dta` files, logs containing identifiers, or generated output folders. The ignored `Data/` directory is the default local location for private inputs and private generated Stata datasets.

## Canonical execution
Run from the repository root. Arguments to `run_all.do` are `profile`, `data_dir`, `output_root`, and optional `run_id`.

```bash
stata-mp -b do run_all.do smoke
scripts/run_smoke.sh
```

- `smoke` is the default and accepts only `data/synthetic/Working NRH SCI.csv`. NRH-005 has not yet supplied that approved fixture, so smoke currently fails with a deliberate missing-fixture error.
- `full` requires an explicit approved restricted-data directory containing `Working NRH SCI.csv`.
- `release` requires the same restricted input and filename and refuses to overwrite existing derived `.dta` files.
- Restricted profiles never use or fall back to the synthetic fixture.
- Every admitted run uses a unique path-safe run ID and refuses to overwrite an existing run directory; explicit run IDs must also be opaque and non-sensitive.
- Dependency preflight prepends `vendor/stata/plus/`, discards cached
  user-written programs, verifies all seven files, and fails before input
  access on any mismatch or uncontrolled resolution.
- All canonical profiles enforce source-contract version 2 in strict mode
  before preprocessing. Development warning mode is available only by direct
  validator invocation and structural drift always fails.
- Preprocessing executes mapping-contract version 1, using normalized
  allowlisted literals, explicit missing actions, stable target codes and
  labels, and reject-unlisted behavior. Composite variables are derived
  directly from mapped numeric codes with missing-value guards.
- Full and release dependency resolution is offline. Executable analysis code
  must not install or update packages at runtime.

```bash
stata-mp -b do run_all.do full "/approved/data" "/approved/output"
stata-mp -b do run_all.do release "/approved/data" "/approved/output" "path-safe-run-id"
```

The smoke launchers translate Stata's return code into the process status, including on macOS. Direct execution of the three legacy scripts remains supported; two-argument calls retain the historical dated-output behavior.

## Expected outputs
- Private generated datasets: `<data_dir>/nrh-sci-raw.dta` and `<data_dir>/nrh-sci-cleaned.dta`; direct legacy defaults use `Data/`.
- Canonical publication outputs: unique folders under `Results and Figures/<run_id>/`.
- Canonical value-free evidence: `<run_id>/run_all.log` and `<run_id>/run_manifest.csv`.
- Detailed logs: `<run_id>/Logs/`, including dependency-preflight evidence.
- Legacy standalone outputs: dated folders under `Results and Figures/<date>/`.
- Generated outputs are not tracked in git.

## Agent cautions
- Preserve the legacy analysis logic unless a future task explicitly asks for scientific refactoring.
- Preserve the eight approved NRH-004 decisions, including Male sex with female
  reference, C1-C8 and AIS A-D domains, field-specific missing actions, and
  `nrh_admin_censor_date_iso` = 2023-09-30. A censor-date change
  requires a new signed decision and full baseline review.
- Preserve the exact vendored dependency closure and manifest hashes unless a
  reviewed dependency ticket explicitly authorizes a change.
- Never substitute unapproved synthetic data or route a restricted profile to the public fixture.
- Link to the open-access SAGE article and PubMed record; do not mirror full article text in the repository.
- Keep README, `llms.txt`, `CITATION.cff`, `AGENTS.md`, `DECISIONS.md`, mapping
  contracts, and data dictionary metadata synchronized after article, release,
  decision, or workflow changes.
- Run `git diff --check`, parse `CITATION.cff`, and search for hard-coded local paths before publishing changes.
